title: We drew monsters, and then we showed the teacher.
scene: 问他和朋友今天干了啥。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did you do with Sam?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We drew monsters, and then we showed the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She said mine was the scariest.

variations: "drew monsters" 换 "built a fort"；"showed the teacher" 换 "showed Mom"。
